data.title: Automated Exfiltration of Staged Data
data.summary: The sample exfiltrates staged data automatically on a schedule or threshold, without requiring an operator to issue a manual transfer command each time.
data.description:
Automating exfiltration removes the operator from the critical path entirely: data leaves
on a timer or once a size threshold is reached, over whichever channel the sample's C2
already uses, requiring no live interaction. This is efficient for the operator but also
predictable for defenders — a transfer that recurs on a fixed schedule or fires at a
consistent data-volume threshold is a more regular pattern than an operator-driven,
irregular one.
data.recommendation:
* Profile outbound transfer timing and volume for regularity (fixed interval, consistent size threshold) as a detection signal distinct from destination-based blocking alone.
* Block or rate-limit the exfiltration channel at the point of egress once identified, since the schedule will otherwise simply continue regardless of operator availability.
* Recover the staged data queued for transfer, if intercepted before the scheduled send, to establish exactly what left and what did not.
data.short_recommendation: Profile outbound transfer timing and volume for the regularity a scheduled, automated exfiltration produces.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Checked a local staging directory's size on a fixed timer and triggered an upload over the existing C2 channel once a threshold was exceeded.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Triggered exfiltration automatically on a size threshold rather than waiting for an operator-issued command.
